2608.31084.title: The First Token Is a Clue: Verbalizing Multi-Token Concepts from the J-lens
2608.31084.paper_summary: The Jacobian Lens (J-lens) is a recent tool for interpreting LLMs. It reads a hidden state as a ranked list of vocabulary tokens, leaving multi-token concepts without a representation of their own. The original J-lens work addresses this limitation with Template Lens, which precomputes vectors for a fixed phrase vocabulary, and Oracle Lens, which fine-tunes components to propose phrases and reconstruct phrase vectors. We ask whether multi-token concepts and their vectors can instead be recovered directly from J-lens and the frozen model. We find that the first token of a multi-token concept is about as readable as a single-token concept. Given the correct first token and source prompt, the frozen model recovers the second token in 88.3% of two-token cases. We show that a vector for the complete concept can be recovered from subsequent hidden states in a single forward pass. We therefore use J-lens to propose first tokens and let the frozen model complete candidate concepts. We then recover a vector for each candidate and score it alongside the complete vocabulary. Across 496 multi-hop clozes on Gemma-3-12B-IT, Llama-3.1-8B, and Qwen3-14B, our method achieves an average $\mathrm{Rank@}10$ of 43.1%, compared with 27.6% for Template Lens. Without the J-lens clue, performance drops to 21.6%, showing that the first-token clue substantially improves readout. Causal concept swaps using the recovered vectors achieve an average $\mathrm{succ}@10$ of 61.4%, compared with 26.2% for Template Lens under the same intervention. These results show that first-token clues can guide multi-token concept recovery, while subsequent hidden states provide vectors for readout and intervention.
2608.31084.paper_summary_zh: Jacobian Lens (J-lens) 是一種最近用於解釋 LLM 的工具。它將隱藏狀態讀取為一個按排名排列的詞彙標記列表，導致多標記概念沒有自己的表示。原始的 J-lens 研究通過模板透鏡（Template Lens）來解決這一限制，該方法為固定短語詞彙預計算向量，以及通過 Oracle Lens 微調組件以提出短語並重建短語向量。我們詢問是否可以直接從 J-lens 和凍結模型中恢復多標記概念及其向量。我們發現多標記概念的第一個標記的可讀性與單標記概念相當。給定正確的第一個標記和來源提示，凍結模型在 88.3% 的雙標記案例中恢復第二個標記。我們顯示可以從隨後的隱藏狀態中在單次前向傳遞中恢復完整概念的向量。因此，我們使用 J-lens 提出第一個標記，並讓凍結模型完成候選概念。然後，我們為每個候選恢復一個向量，並與完整詞彙一起進行評分。在 Gemma-3-12B-IT、Llama-3.1-8B 和 Qwen3-14B 上的 496 個多跳填空中，我們的方法達到了平均 $\mathrm{Rank@}10$ 為 43.1%，而模板透鏡的結果為 27.6%。在沒有 J-lens 提示的情況下，性能下降至 21.6%，顯示第一標記提示顯著改善了讀出。使用恢復的向量進行的因果概念交換在相同干預下達到平均 $\mathrm{succ}@10$ 為 61.4%，而模板透鏡的結果為 26.2%。這些結果顯示第一標記提示可以指導多標記概念的恢復，而隨後的隱藏狀態提供讀出和干預的向量。
